correctness.rationale: Integral Lefschetz gives H^(2j)(Y,Z)=Z generated by the hyperplane class below complex dimension 2m and zero odd groups. The free C2 Cartan–Leray E2 page has only even total degrees there and hence no differential. The linearized O_Y(1) and the character line bundle lift the multiplicative filtration generators, proving all k independent Z/2 classes and no hidden Z/4 extension. Holomorphic Lefschetz gives K_X equal to the character bundle; the exponential sequence and H^3(X,Z)=0 prove Pic and Brauer statements. The included actual finite checker validates only second-page tables.

value.rationale: The published comparison uses second Betti numbers and rational Hodge dimensions, which cannot see integral torsion. Here a natural full Lefschetz-range cohomology ring shows systematically increasing two-torsion, nonvanishing powers of the canonical Chern class, precise Picard torsion, and Brauer-group vanishing, which matter for topological and Brauer-theoretic distinction of Enriques constructions. The range is the geometrically forced pre-middle range, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
